attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

mcd14-1.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

mcd14-2.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

mcd14-3.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

mcd14-4.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

mcd14-5.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

mcd14-6.flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

attacks.name: Continuous Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

mcd14-7.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

mcd14-8.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

mcd14-9.flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

mcd14-10.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

attacks.name: Razor Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

mcd14-11.flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

mcd14-12.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
